zh.title: flydubai 租借 737-800 貨機啟動專機航班
zh.summary: flydubai 租借 737-800 貨機啟動專機運營；未來將引進 787 擴張
body: flydubai 正在租借波音 737-800 貨機，以補充其腹艙貨運產品並正式啟動專機貨運航班。
消息來自 Simple Flying 於 2026 年 9 月 11 日發布的報導，標題指出 flydubai 作為阿聯酋航空的姊妹航空公司，正推出專屬貨機服務。
報導指出，flydubai 將以租賃方式引進 737-800 貨機，這標誌著其貨運業務邁出關鍵一步。
同一文章亦提到，flydubai 未來將隨著波音 787 客機的交付進一步擴大貨運規模。

en.title: flydubai Launches Boeing 737-800 Freighter Flights, Plans 787 Growth
en.summary: flydubai leases 737-800 freighters to launch dedicated cargo flights; plans 787 expansion
body: flydubai is leasing Boeing 737-800 freighters to augment its belly cargo offerings and launch dedicated freighter flights, according to a Simple Flying report published on 11 September 2026.

The article notes that the Dubai-based carrier, often referred to as Emirates' sister airline, will operate the 737-800 freighters under a lease arrangement, marking a significant step in its cargo expansion.
The same report adds that flydubai plans further cargo growth with the future arrival of Boeing 787 aircraft.
The move signals the carrier's commitment to building a dedicated freighter fleet alongside its passenger operations.

zh.title: 空中巴士啟動庫藏股買回計畫 上限410萬股
zh.summary: 空中巴士11日起執行庫藏股買回；上限410萬股；至11月6日止
body: 空中巴士（Airbus SE，股票代號AIR）表示，自2026年9月11日起開始執行一項庫藏股買回計畫，目的在於支持未來的員工持股計畫以及權益基礎的薪酬計畫。
該公司在新聞稿中指出，這項計畫將在公開市場進行，執行期間自2026年9月11日起，最遲於2026年11月6日結束，最多買回4,100,000股。
空中巴士已委任一家投資公司管理執行，該投資公司將獨立於空中巴士決定買進時點。
此計畫依據2026年4月14日股東大會授予董事會的授權，最多可買回公司已發行股本之10%，目的在支持未來員工持股及權益薪酬，並避免稀釋現有股東權益。

en.title: Airbus starts share buyback to support employee share plans, up to 4.1m shares
en.summary: Airbus SE starts buyback on 11 Sep 2026; up to 4.1m shares; ends by 6 Nov
body: Airbus SE (stock exchange symbol: AIR) said it is commencing a share buyback programme to support future employee share ownership plan activities and equity-based compensation plans.
The programme will be executed in the open market over a period beginning on 11 September 2026 and ending no later than 06 November 2026, for up to a maximum number of 4,100,000 shares.
Airbus has mandated an investment firm to manage the execution, with the firm making trading decisions on timing independently of Airbus.

The programme is undertaken pursuant to shareholder authority granted at the 2026 Annual General Meeting and is intended to avoid dilution of existing shareholders while supporting future employee share ownership plan activities and equity-based compensation.
